semanticReviewNotes: Buffing: preserved preceding-process scratches, friction heat/shape damage and equipment-specific entanglement restrictions.
Hydrometry: retained temperature/calibration/meniscus conditions and no universal concentration conversion.
Chemistry: retained titration endpoint/equivalence distinction, reaction stoichiometry, exact volume conversions, solution-final-volume denominator and oxide errata qualifications.
Materials: retained density vs specific gravity and mass estimate vs material/lifting authorization distinctions; Cu-Zn/Cu-Sn/Cu-Ni relationships kept.
Processes: retained degreasing/activation distinctions, delay/drag-in records, defect hypotheses vs confirmed causes and hold/dispatch authority.
Hot dip: preserved moisture/high-temperature hazards and no assumption of safe dryness from visible plane alone.
Electroless/PVD/CVD: retained reduction/displacement/self-catalysis distinctions and method-specific controls.
Environment: preserved transparent effluent/pH insufficiency, segregation/no unapproved neutralization, exhaust/noise tradeoffs and current-rule verification caveats.

Four surface diagram captions preserve current efficiency definition, measured process-condition report, g/L vs mol/L denominator and all ideal series/parallel numeric examples with no-equipment-wiring caveat.
limitations: Independent AI comparison is not native Thai or domain certification.
